subject: Request: Solaris early-access incentive + trial extension
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Solaris early-access incentive + trial extension

Hi Marissa / Soojin,

Quick ask — Solaris (contact: Laura Chen, laura@solaris.ai) is live on a 30-day pilot and has shown heavy burst usage the last two weeks. They asked for two exception items to complete the pilot conversion conversation:

  - One-time usage credit: $50,000 applied to pilot consumption (to cover anticipated token surge over the next 4 weeks)
  - Trial extension: additional 30 days (total pilot length 60 days)
  - Supplemental ask: 25% discount on Year 1 list for a 12-month renewal if they convert within 45 days after pilot close

Why I want the exception: their PoC is high-confidence (engineering references, product fit), and the CTO committed to a pilot demo for three internal teams if we accommodate the burst credits + short extension. Without a concession, they are pausing activity and we risk losing momentum.

Proposal (what I suggest we approve):
  - Approve up to $30k one-time credit (applied to pilot invoice),
  - Approve a single 30-day extension (to 60 days total),
  - Approve a time-limited 20% discount on Year 1 if they sign a 12-month renewal within 45 days of pilot close, with minimum commit of $75k ARR.

Attachments: signed MOA (they returned a doc), usage snapshot (last 7 days).

Can you advise whether you can greenlight the above or if I should route to finance/exec for the full $50k / 25% ask? Need an answer by Monday EOD (20 Jun) — customer wants written confirmation to restart embeddings run.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Solaris Systems (Pilot: infra + embedding pipeline)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Solaris early-access incentive + trial extension

Karthik — thanks for the summary. Can you send:

  1) a three-line ROI/close rationale (why $50k buys conversion probability),
  2) the current pilot usage trend (hourly/day) and estimated overrun without credits,
  3) whether legal needs to review the 25% concession (term language / minimums).

If the ask is defensible, I'm comfortable approving up to $30k + a 30-day extension and the 20% discount on the conditions you outlined. If you want the full $50k or 25% off for a full year without a commit, escalate to me with the HubSpot deal link + signed MOA and I'll push to Soojin for exec signoff.

- Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Solaris early-access incentive + trial extension

Thanks Marissa — details below.

1) Short ROI/close rationale:
   - CTO (Marco Rivera) has committed to a cross-team pilot review on 2027-08-05 contingent on us covering pilot overrun and giving an extra 30 days to validate the recommender workload. If we pause now, pilot conclusion slips 6+ weeks and internal champion momentum drops.
   - Sales signal: procurement indicated they can fast-track a PO if we provide letter confirming credits + extension; they expect at least $150k ARR in Year 1 if teams convert.

2) Usage snapshot and estimate:
   - Last 7 days average consumption: 420k tokens/day (embedding + normal inference); peak days 1.1M tokens.
   - Forecasted next 30 days w/o changes (expected final evaluation runs): ~1.2M tokens/day -> projected overrun = ~$58k at current list rates.

3) Legal: The 25% discount requires a minimal renewal commitment; legal prefers explicit SaaS order form language. I attached the signed MOA and the usage CSV; legal flagged no blocker but will need the final order form updated before discount applies.

Requested action: please approve the conservative proposal (30k credit + 30d extension + 20% limited discount) so I can confirm immediately. If you want to sign off on the full ask ($50k + 25% for 12 months without the $75k commit), mark "escalate" and I'll pull Soojin in for exec approval.

Attachments: solar-usage-weekly-20270614.csv, Solaris_MOA_signed.pdf

-Karthik

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Solaris early-access incentive + trial extension

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed. I appreciate the level-setting. Approvals below with conditions: 

  - One-time credit: APPROVED $30,000 to be applied to pilot consumption only.
  - Trial extension: APPROVED +30 days (pilot end -> new end date 2027-07-15).
  - Discount: APPROVED 20% off Year 1 list BUT only if they sign a 12-month renewal with a minimum first-year ARR of $75,000 within 45 days of pilot close. Discount applies to the first invoice only and is subject to legal-approved order form.

Conditions & Notes:
  - Finance: apply credit as a line item on final pilot invoice; credits are non-refundable and expire after 90 days if unused.
  - Legal: update order form to reflect minimum commitment and attach signed MOA.
  - Sales: capture the PO and renewal timeline in HubSpot; I want the deal stage moved to "Commitment" once PO is received.

If you need the full $50k or the 25% unconditional, escalate to me with justification for the extra subsidy and the incremental likelihood of conversion. For now, the above is approved.

Soojin
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Solaris pilot — approved credits, extension, and conditional discount

Laura — thanks for the quick turns this week. Short and concrete confirmation of what Redwood approved: 

  1) One-time pilot credit: $30,000 applied to Solaris pilot consumption (to be shown as a credit line on the pilot invoice).
  2) Pilot extension: an additional 30 days; new pilot end date is 2027-07-15.
  3) Conditional discount: 20% off Year 1 list, conditional on signing a 12-month renewal within 45 days after the pilot close and a minimum first-year ARR of $75,000. Discount will be reflected on the first invoice and only applies after Legal signs the order form.

Action items for Solaris:
  - Please confirm you accept these terms in writing and share the expected PO timeline.
  - Share any updated order-form language you prefer for the 20% concession so Legal can review quickly.

I've attached the MOA you returned and the usage snapshot for reference. Marissa & Soojin — thanks for the fast review and approval.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
